Born in [[Queens, New York]], he attended the [[University of Virginia]] where he played for their [[Virginia Cavaliers men's basketball|basketball team]].{{cite web|title=JAMAL ROBINSON|url=http://www.msgrmcclancy.org/s/264/16/interior.aspx?pgid=1180|website=msgrmcclancy.org|accessdate=April 3, 2018|archive-date=April 4, 2018|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180404073920/http://www.msgrmcclancy.org/s/264/16/interior.aspx?pgid=1180|url-status=dead}} He attended [[Monsignor McClancy Memorial High School]], where he graduated from in 1993. Robinson is the first Monsignor McClancy Memorial High School alumni to play in the NBA.
